# VV Builders

> VV Builders is a design-build architecture and construction studio delivering residential, commercial, and interiors projects across the United States, from concept through completion.

VV Builders was founded in 2009 and has completed 320+ projects with a 98% client satisfaction rate and 25+ industry awards. The studio integrates architecture, construction, interiors, and project management under one team and one contract.

## Company

- Name: VV Builders
- Website: https://www.vvbuilders.com
- Email: hello@vvbuilders.com
- Phone: +1 (212) 555-0198
- Address: 123 Design Avenue, New York, NY 10001, US
- Services: Architecture, Residential Construction, Commercial Builds, Interiors, Project Management
